thread:
Maya: Quick thread — we need a final dry rehearsal checklist + cue flow for the webinar. Can folks confirm speaker availability and backup plans by EOD?
Sam J: Topic suggestion: 'Operational playbook for inference: routing, fallbacks, and cost controls' — shorter abstract helps.
Alina: +1 on that topic. Abstract idea: 3 real patterns (low-latency, cost-sensitive, regulated) and how routing+quantization choices map to each.
Devon: I can do the live demo but want a clear fallback clip if the model endpoint flakes. Can we have a 90s pre-recorded clip ready?
Priya: I’ll draft the pre-recorded demo steps. Plan to record on Wed 10am PT.
Maya: Good. Also need speaker bios (1-2 lines) and headshots. @Sam J can you collect from panelists?
Sam J: pinged @Lucas and @Devon for bios.
Lucas: Got it. Sending bios in 30m. Also can provide a short customer quote we can read.
Maya: Lead routing: ops asks that registrant metadata (company size + vertical) be sent to Salesforce with UTM. Default routing: NA -> AE pool A, EMEA -> AE pool B, APAC -> SDR handoff. Anyone object?
Priya: That routing works. Add a fallback: if company size >= 1000, route to enterprise AE immediately.
Alina: Rehearsal slots: dry run (no slides) Thursday 11am PT, full run Friday 9am PT, tech check 30m before live. Confirm?
Devon: Confirmed for both.
Maya: AV ops checklist (short):
```
- Confirm streaming key
- Record locally as backup
- Mute panelists on entry
- Test screen-share + audio for demo machine
- Confirm captioning service enabled
```
OpsBot: Reminder: landing page published and calendar invites sent (https://redwood.ai/webinar).
Maya: Run-of-show draft (short):
```
00:00 - Welcome & TL;DR (Maya) 3m
03:00 - Product narrative + benchmarks (Sam) 8m
11:00 - Live demo (Devon) 12m -> fallback clip at 13:30 if issues
23:00 - Panel discussion + customer story (Alina + Lucas) 12m
35:00 - Q&A moderated (Priya) 15m
50:00 - CTA + followups 5m
```
Sam J: For benchmarks slide, include latency percentiles (p50/p90), tokens/sec, and cost per 1M tokens — keep numbers tied to the demo workload.
Maya: Messaging callouts: emphasize predictable serving, routing policies, and SLO-driven fallbacks. Keep the CTA: 'Get a performance consult + pilot credits'.
Priya: I'll prepare two canned answers for the moderator: one for security/KMS questions and one for model quality/regression.
Devon: Ops contingency: if live demo fails, cut to pre-recorded clip and call out the exact timestamp to resume. Also mark slide where we show 'How we reroute'.
Maya: Final asks from everyone: slides by Thu EOD, pre-recorded demo uploaded by Thu noon, rehearsal attendance mandatory. Reactions to confirm please :thumbsup:
Lucas: 👍
Sam J: 👍
Alina: 👍
Devon: 👍
Priya: 👍
Maya: Thanks — I’ll stitch this into the run deck and send the rehearsal calendar invites.
